## Description

Use Soft Actor-Critic to learn continuous exposure or allocation actions with an entropy-regularized objective.

## Where it may fit

Experimental settings where continuous position sizing and robust exploration are useful.

## Vehicles

Research stock/ETF, futures or crypto allocation environments.

## Required data

Market features, portfolio state, action bounds, rewards, costs, environment and chronological splits.

## Caveats

Requires careful reward/action design and extensive robustness testing; a backtest is not deployment evidence.
